title: Kick synthesis parameters
description: Draft v0.2 - finalised in Phase 01. Input to the deterministic kick engine. Out-of-range values are rejected, never clamped. Time t in the field descriptions is measured from the first sample of the file. v0.2 (issue #7): envelope semantics written down; pitch_decay_ms default 40 -> 15.

bpm.description: Context only; used for naming/metadata and length hints.

pitch_start_hz.description: Body frequency at t = 0. Must not be lower than pitch_end_hz.

pitch_end_hz.description: Asymptote of the pitch fall, not a guaranteed tail pitch: the body only gets close to it if the pitch settles before the kick fades or ends (see pitch_decay_ms).

pitch_decay_ms.description: Time constant tau of the exponential pitch fall: f(t) = pitch_end_hz + (pitch_start_hz - pitch_end_hz) * exp(-t / tau). After 1 tau 63 % of the fall is done, after 2.3 tau 90 %. It is not the time until the pitch arrives. Guideline for presets and Claude, not enforced by this schema: pitch_decay_ms <= audio_engine.params.max_settled_pitch_decay_ms(params), i.e. the pitch is within 5 % of pitch_end_hz by the time the level has fallen 20 dB (or at length_ms, if the file ends earlier). The guideline is about this curve; a measured tail pitch (sidecar fundamental_hz) averages over an earlier window and can still be higher. Larger values give a deliberately 'pitchy' kick whose audible tail stays above pitch_end_hz; use them only when that is asked for.

amp_attack_ms.description: Linear rise from 0 to full level, starting at t = 0.

amp_decay_ms.description: Time for the level to fall by 60 dB, measured from the end of the attack. Exponential decay: -20 dB after amp_decay_ms / 3, -40 dB after 2/3 of it. If length_ms is shorter, the kick is cut off before it has decayed (the engine adds a 5 ms fade-out).

preset.description: Name of the preset these values came from, if any.
